follow_up_tasks_has_subject.name: follow_up_tasks_has_subject
follow_up_tasks_has_subject.value: "follow_up_tasks"."lead_id" IS NOT NULL OR "follow_up_tasks"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL

lead_activities_has_subject.name: lead_activities_has_subject
lead_activities_has_subject.value: "lead_activities"."lead_id" IS NOT NULL OR "lead_activities"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL

payments_sign.name: payments_sign
payments_sign.value: ("payments"."voids_payment_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."amount" > 0) OR ("payments"."voids_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."amount" < 0)

production_jobs_output_sold_needs_record.name: production_jobs_output_sold_needs_recorded
production_jobs_output_sold_needs_record.value: "production_jobs"."output_sold_at" IS NULL OR "production_jobs"."output_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL

after_sales_resolved_has_resolution.name: after_sales_resolved_has_resolution
after_sales_resolved_has_resolution.value: "after_sales_cases"."status" NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') OR "after_sales_cases"."resolution" IS NOT NULL

deliveries_window_order.name: deliveries_window_order
deliveries_window_order.value: "deliveries"."window_start" IS NULL OR "deliveries"."window_end" IS NULL OR "deliveries"."window_start" < "deliveries"."window_end"

expenses_void_has_reason.name: expenses_void_has_reason
expenses_void_has_reason.value: "expenses"."voided_at" IS NULL OR ("expenses"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "expenses"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL)
